The 1941–42 season was [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol's 39th season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga|10th consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
With superb performances of forward Manuel Alday,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/blogs/ni-mas-ni-menos/2016/11/12/manuel-alday-el-ariete-del-madrid-de-los.html|title=Manuel Alday the 40s goalscorer who scored 23 League goals|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=12 November 2016|accessdate=20 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> the club finished the league season as runners-up, seven points below champions Valencia CF.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/valencia/centenario/album/2019/03/18/5c8aa248ca47419c418b4619_8.html|title=Chronic of Valencia against Real Madrid 1942|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=2 April 2020|accessdate=10 December 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2017/03/22/primera/1490199747_882117.html|title=The 11 players who clinched the title 75 years ago|publisher=as.com|date=22 March 2017|accessdate=22 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> Surprisingly, the squad lost at home against Celta, which shattered its options of clinching the league title.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lavozdegalicia.es/noticia/gradario/hemeroteca/2016/03/22/celta-vencia-primera-vez-casa-real-madrid/00031458637012888248951.htm|work=La Voz de Galicia|title=Celta Defeated Real Madrid at Chamartín|date=22 March 2016|accessdate=10 December 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> In the [[1942 Copa del Generalísimo|Copa del Generalísimo]], Madrid reached the quarter-finals, where they lost to Club Atlético de Bilbao in a playoff match after a 3–3 aggregate tie.
